people.name: Ahimelech
people.line: High Priest at Nob who helped David, killed by Saul

translations.web: The king said, “You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you, and all your father’s house.”
translations.bsb: But the king replied, “You will surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s house!”
translations.kjv: And the king said, Thou shalt surely die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father's house.
translations.asv: And the king said, Thou shalt surely die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father's house.
